briefdescription.para: Copy pixels that are already painted on the device of a painter.

detaileddescription.para: In a widget paint event, the painter draws into the window backing store. This function reads what the window has painted there so far, for example the content under a widget that wants to blur it. It replaces QPlatformBackingStore::toImage().

simplesect.para: Call it while the painter is active, before you paint over the area.

parameterdescription.para: Active borrowed painter, for example one opened on a widget in its paint event.
Area in the logical coordinates of the painter.

simplesect.para: Copy in device pixels. Like QImage::copy(), parts outside the device are filled with zero bytes, which is transparent for formats with alpha. Its device pixel ratio is the one of the painted widget or image. Returns a null image when the painter is inactive or its device is neither a QImage nor a QPixmap.
